item.text: I’ll read `input.json` and check each candidate start against the availability, blackout, and deadline constraints.

item.command: /bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; p=json.loads(Path(\"input.json\").read_text()); d=p[\"duration\"]; starts=[s for s in range(p[\"window_start\"], min(p[\"window_end\"],p[\"deadline\"])-d+1) if all(all(any(a <= t < b for a,b in intervals) for t in range(s,s+d)) for intervals in p[\"teams\"].values()) and not any(s < b and a < s+d for a,b in p[\"blackouts\"])]; print(json.dumps({\"feasible_starts\":starts,\"earliest\":min(starts) if starts else None,\"latest\":max(starts) if starts else None},separators=(\",\",\":\")))'"
